_companionFile: Building with SAP Signavio – companion file S16
_howToUse: This file documents the metric collections of Velora (Table 16.18 and Section 16.11) in a readable JSON structure. It is an EXAMPLE, not SAP Signavio's own export format: to move metrics between workspaces, use Export and Import on the Customizable Metrics tab, which use the product's own JSON.

To rebuild a metric: open Analysis Configuration > your process > Customizable Metrics > Create Metric, enter name and description, keep the aggregation type, paste the signal expression, and create the variables first on the Variables tab (Section 16.11).

Metrics marked "printed metric" in source are exactly as in the book; "derived" ones are written for this file from the book's queries and were not shown as metrics in the book. Test every metric in the preview before you use it (PD-056).
Business thresholds are variables owned by the process owner (PD-054). Durations: SiGNAL compares them with literals such as DURATION '1day'.
_fictional: All names and data are fictional: Velora Group SE is invented for the book. resultInBook values are those printed in Chapter 16 on the companion data.

metrics.name: Invoice correction rate
metrics.description: Share of orders with a credit memo (Velora calls it the invoice correction rate). Mandate P3: under 4%.
metrics.signal:
COUNT(case_id) FILTER (WHERE (SELECT BOOL_OR(event_name = 'Create credit memo')))
  * 100.0 / COUNT(case_id)

metrics.name: Late price change rate
metrics.description: Share of orders with Change price after credit release (rule PD-047). Decision PD-050.
metrics.signal:
COUNT(case_id) FILTER (WHERE (SELECT BOOL_OR(event_name = 'Change price after credit release')))
  * 100.0 / COUNT(case_id)

metrics.name: Credit block rate
metrics.description: Share of orders blocked for credit at least once. Counts cases, not events.
metrics.signal:
COUNT(case_id) FILTER (WHERE (SELECT BOOL_OR(event_name = 'Block for credit')))
  * 100.0 / COUNT(case_id)
metrics.source: Derived for this file from the pattern of the printed metrics (Section 16.11) and query Q25 (Section 16.6); not printed as a metric in the book

metrics.name: Release without review
metrics.description: Orders released but never reviewed: the phone releases at Brno.
metrics.signal:
COUNT(case_id) FILTER (
  WHERE (SELECT BOOL_OR(event_name = 'Release credit block'))
    AND NOT (SELECT BOOL_OR(event_name = 'Review blocked order'))
)

metrics.name: Order to first invoice
metrics.description: Median duration from the first event (Create sales order) to the first invoice. Displayed as a duration.
metrics.signal:
MEDIAN((SELECT FIRST(end_time) FILTER (WHERE event_name = 'Create invoice'))
     - (SELECT FIRST(end_time)))
metrics.source: Derived for this file from query Q16 (Section 16.5); not printed as a metric in the book

metrics.name: Goods issue to invoice (orders over target)
metrics.description: Share of orders whose first invoice comes more than billing_target_days after the last goods issue. With 3 days: 28.6%.
metrics.signal:
100.0 * COUNT(case_id) FILTER (
    WHERE (SELECT FIRST(end_time) WHERE event_name = 'Create invoice')
        - (SELECT LAST(end_time)  WHERE event_name = 'Post goods issue')
      > ${Variable.billing_target_days} * DURATION '1day'
  ) / COUNT(case_id)

variables.name: billing_target_days
variables.description: Target in days from the last goods issue to the first invoice. Owner: O2C process owner (PD-054).

metrics.name: Goods issue to invoice (days)
metrics.description: Average from the FIRST goods issue to the first invoice; partial deliveries make it longer than the median of Section 16.5.
metrics.signal:
AVG(
  (SELECT FIRST(end_time) WHERE event_name = 'Create invoice')
  - (SELECT FIRST(end_time) WHERE event_name = 'Post goods issue')
)

metrics.name: Invoice to payment
metrics.description: Median duration from the first invoice to the clearing of the payment (PD-048). Use on paid orders (Case status = complete).
metrics.signal:
MEDIAN((SELECT LAST(end_time)  FILTER (WHERE event_name = 'Clear payment'))
     - (SELECT FIRST(end_time) FILTER (WHERE event_name = 'Create invoice')))
metrics.source: Derived for this file from the query in "The Price of a Correction" (Section 16.9); not printed as a metric in the book

metrics.name: After-the-fact PO rate
metrics.description: Share of PO items where the supplier invoice arrived before the purchase order was created.
metrics.source: Derived for this file from the query in Section 16.12; not printed as a metric in the book

metrics.name: Late after-the-fact PO rate
metrics.description: Share of PO items whose PO was created more than atf_tolerance_days after the invoice.
metrics.signal:
COUNT(case_id) FILTER (WHERE
    (SELECT FIRST(end_time) FILTER (WHERE event_name = 'Create purchase order'))
  - (SELECT FIRST(end_time) FILTER (WHERE event_name = 'Receive invoice'))
  > ${Variable.atf_tolerance_days} * DURATION '1day')
* 100.0 / COUNT(case_id)

variables.name: atf_tolerance_days
variables.description: Tolerance in days between invoice and PO before a PO counts as late after the fact. 7 in Table 16.18; Procurement set it to 5 in Month 8.
